name: National Securities Depository
summary: National Securities Depository Limited (NSDL) is a prominent Indian entity delivering a comprehensive suite of depository and allied financial services. Its operations are structured across three primary divisions: Depository, Database Management Services, and Banking Services. The Depository segment offers crucial support to investors by enabling the dematerialisation, rematerialisation, secure electronic holding, transfer, and pledging of securities. It further streamlines operations for market intermediaries through straight-through processing facilities and empowers companies with e-voting services. Within Database Management Services, NSDL manages several specialized platforms and registries. These include the National Skills Registry for the IT and ITeS industries, the SEZ online system on behalf of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, and its function as a KYC Registration Agency (KRA) for centralizing Know Your Customer records across the securities market. This segment also oversees operations related to the Repository of Insurance Policies. The Banking Services arm provides a diverse range of financial offerings. It accepts demand deposits, encompassing both savings and current accounts, and facilitates various payment, remittance, and recharge services via its dedicated mobile application. NSDL also issues debit cards for Point-of-Sale, e-commerce, and ATM transactions, supports domestic money transfers through Business Correspondents, and allows investment in mutual funds and insurance via its mobile app. Additionally, it offers bank verification services tailored for corporate brokers. Beyond these core business lines, NSDL provides electronic custody and trade settlement solutions. Its value-added services include the pledging and hypothecation of securities, automated delivery of securities to clearing corporations, distribution of corporate benefits (both cash and non-cash), stock lending facilities, and the dematerialisation of National Savings Certificates (NSC), Kisan Vikas Patras (KVP), and warehouse receipts. The company's digital infrastructure extends to various e-Services. SPEED-e allows demat account holders and clearing members to directly submit instructions online. IDeAS is an internet-based service enabling demat account holders to conveniently access their account balances and transaction histories. STeADY facilitates the electronic delivery of contract notes from brokers to custodians and fund managers. An online interface for depository account validation allows subscribers to verify DP ID, client ID, and PAN details. Lastly, SPICE offers an efficient way to electronically submit instructions based on power of attorney for clients. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai, India, National Securities Depository Limited was formerly known as NSDL Depository Limited, adopting its current name in January 2013.
